Package edu.mit.rocket_team.telemetry

Class RTTelemetryEngine

java.lang.Object
edu.mit.rocket_team.telemetry.RTTelemetryEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class RTTelemetryEngine extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Deterministic byte queue in place of the FC's CC1200, no RF simulation.
